faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Quick answers on cancellation, live tracking links, support, and prohibited delivery items.
faq.q1: Can I cancel a rider booking?
faq.a1: Free cancellation is available before a rider is assigned. Once a rider is assigned, the full delivery fee will be charged.
faq.q2: How will the receiver/customer know the status of their delivery?
faq.a2: After you book a delivery, a real-time tracking link will be provided. You can share this link with the receiver or customer so they can monitor the delivery status at any time.
faq.q3: Where can I access support for order-related problems?
faq.a3: Support is available through the Help Center in our website, where you can get assistance for both current and past bookings.
faq.q4: What items are prohibited from delivery?
faq.a4: For safety, legal, and operational reasons, certain items are strictly prohibited from being sent via Wing Express. These include:
faq.prohibitedItem2: Jewelry, precious metals, or valuable collectibles
faq.prohibitedItem4: Hazardous or flammable materials (e.g. chemicals, fuel, gas)
faq.prohibitedItem5: Explosives, weapons, or sharp dangerous objects
faq.prohibitedItem7: Liquids that may leak or spill
faq.prohibitedItem10: Items that violate local laws or regulations
faq.stillHaveQuestionsSubtitle: We understand. Let's get in touch directly with our team, then.
